decision.rationale: Rejected and removed. Shared staging preserved exact coefficient and independently decoded product hashes while reducing statically counted source-load traffic, and several stage cells improved. The priority full-encode point estimate improved only 0.02-0.28% with p=0.06, and its absolute treatment upper bound (5.575540 s) exceeded the baseline lower bound (5.573581 s), so the fail-closed confidence rule did not support promotion. Wide batch 16 crossed no change (-0.130% to +1.879%), and 512 batch 1 significantly regressed 0.429-1.220%. The shared kernels, launch route, switch, trace seam, and candidate-only tests were removed; the generic route and reusable exact stage/product benchmark remain.
